source: synthetic GeM bid for rooftop solar (evals/golden/in/gem_solar_rooftop)

requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 8,00,00,000 in each of the last three financial years.
The bidder shall furnish an EMD of Rs. 15,00,000 through the online gateway before the bid end date.
The bidder shall have at least 7 years of experience commissioning grid-connected rooftop solar plants.
Recognised startups are exempted from the EMD; MSE exemption is not available under this bid.
The bidder shall be empanelled with the state distribution company for net metering work.
5.1 The contractor shall design, supply, install and commission 2.4 MW of rooftop solar capacity within 180 days.
5.2 The contractor shall guarantee a minimum plant availability of 97 percent over the five-year operation period.
5.3 The contractor must use modules and inverters listed in the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers.
5.4 The contractor shall obtain net metering approval from the distribution company before commissioning.
5.5 The contractor shall operate and maintain the plants for five years after commissioning.
5.6 The contractor should provide a remote monitoring portal with daily generation reports.
The technical cover shall not exceed 60 pages excluding datasheets.
Bids shall be submitted on the GeM portal before 03:00 PM IST on 22-12-2026.
The bidder shall digitally sign all covers with a Class 3 DSC and upload the empanelment letter.
Evaluation will be on the lowest levelised cost per kWh over the five-year operation period.
The buyer will verify commissioning certificates for at least 5 MW of completed rooftop capacity.
